description: PROPOSED (issue #107 / Discussion #108, not yet normative): An `llm_judge` grader with a `config` key where `params` was meant. Grader objects are closed (grader.json additionalProperties: false) while `params` itself stays open, so the typo is rejected with UNKNOWN_FIELD at $.config. Derived from a real case: the llm_judge sketch in meta-llama/llama-cookbook#1072 used `config`, which only the raw JSON Schema caught.
